fl()   { echo -e "${RED}❌ ${1}${NC}"; }

kill_port() {
    local port=$1
    local pid
    pid=$(lsof -ti:"$port" 2>/dev/null)
    if [ -n "$pid" ]; then
        kill -9 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
        sleep 1
    fi
}

start_backend() {
    istr "Menjalankan backend..."
    kill_port "$BACKEND_PORT"
    cd "$DIR"
    nohup .venv/bin/uvicorn backend.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port "$BACKEND_PORT" > /tmp/nutrishare-backend.log 2>&1 &
    sleep 4
    if curl -sf "http://localhost:$BACKEND_PORT/health" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        ok "Backend running (port $BACKEND_PORT)"
    else
        fl "Backend gagal start! Cek: tail -20 /tmp/nutrishare-backend.log"
        return 1
    fi
}

start_frontend() {
    istr "Menjalankan frontend..."
    kill_port "$FRONTEND_PORT"
    cd "$DIR/frontend"
    nohup npm run dev > /tmp/nutrishare-frontend.log 2>&1 &
    sleep 5
    if curl -sf "http://localhost:$FRONTEND_PORT" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        ok "Frontend running (port $FRONTEND_PORT)"
    else
        wr "Frontend mungkin butuh waktu lebih, coba buka manual"
    fi
}

stop_backend() {
    kill_port "$BACKEND_PORT" && ok "Backend dihentikan" || wr "Backend tidak running"
}

stop_frontend() {
    kill_port "$FRONTEND_PORT" && ok "Frontend dihentikan" || wr "Frontend tidak running"
}

show_status() {
    echo ""
    echo -e "${CYAN}═══════════════════════════════════${NC}"
    echo -e "${CYAN}        STATUS WEBSITE${NC}"
    echo -e "${CYAN}═══════════════════════════════════${NC}"

    if curl -sf "http://localhost:$BACKEND_PORT/health" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        ok "Backend: RUNNING (http://localhost:$BACKEND_PORT)"
    else
        fl "Backend: DOWN"
    fi

    if curl -sf "http://localhost:$FRONTEND_PORT" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        ok "Frontend: RUNNING (http://localhost:$FRONTEND_PORT)"
    else
        fl "Frontend: DOWN"
    fi
    echo ""
}

run_tests() {

    echo ""

    echo ""
    istr "Selesai"
